gold.label: Metal value (est.)
gold.method: Estimated entire above-ground gold stock, including jewellery, central banks, investment holdings and other uses. Not GLD fund assets and not freely tradable supply.
gold.refresh_mode: spot on asset refresh; stock is a dated estimate

silver.label: Metal value (est.)
silver.method: Estimated entire above-ground silver stock in all forms: 19.3 billion troy ounces at end-2023, repriced at the quoted silver spot price. Stock estimate is older than price; no extrapolation of stock growth. Includes largely immobile fabricated metal, not just investment bullion. Not SLV fund assets or liquid supply.
silver.refresh_mode: spot on asset refresh; stock is a dated estimate

mstr.label: Market cap
mstr.method: Reported common-equity market capitalization. Not enterprise value or the value of Strategy's bitcoin holdings.

mags.label: Fund assets
mags.method: Assets under management of the MAGS ETF, not the combined market capitalization of the seven underlying companies.

sp500.label: Tracked cap*
sp500.method: Sum reported for 499 of 503 constituents (99.2% coverage by count, not by value). Incomplete, third-party aggregate; not the official float-adjusted index capitalization. Underlying observation date not supplied; source checked on the displayed date. Do not add to Nasdaq: constituents overlap.

nasdaq.label: Tracked cap*
nasdaq.method: Sum reported for 2,930 of 3,165 Nasdaq Composite constituents (92.6% coverage by count, not by value). Incomplete, third-party aggregate, not Nasdaq-100 or the value of all exchange listings. Underlying observation date not supplied; source checked on the displayed date. Do not add to S&P 500: constituents overlap.

btc.label: Market cap
btc.method: Circulating-supply market capitalization in USD, not fully diluted valuation. Provider price timing may differ from the chart price.
